data.name: Plastic
data.detailed_description:
You're a plastic soldier fighting to defend the backyard...

Plastic drops 40 players into a one acre backyard for intense team focused tactical combat. This isn't just about getting kills; it is about coordinated combined arms operations. Success requires maintaining logistics networks, executing precision air assaults, and pushing heavy armor through destructible toy cities.

Every action feeds into a team-driven economy. Secure objectives to establish HEMTT supply routes, earn REQ, and purchase the exact weapons, vehicles, and gear needed to counter the enemy. Whether you are sling-loading artillery into position with a CH47 or leading a tank charge through a Bricklyn's financial district, every match demands teamwork and strategic loadout building.

Key Features

  • 1:30 Scale Warfare: Battle across the realistic McAlister family backyard featuring a wooden Log sawmill town, a toy castle kingdom, and a plastic brick metropolis.

  • Player-Driven Economy: Kills and resource extraction earn REQ. Spend it on an open upgrade tree to build custom loadouts on the fly—from dedicated medics to specialized airborne troops.

  • Hardcore Combined Arms: Authentic vehicle physics and squad tactics matter. Form up helicopters to gain formation-buffs for safe insertions, or establish Forward Arming and Refueling Points (FARP) to keep your armor pushing.

  • Dynamic Logistics: Victory relies on supply lines. Protect your HEMTT resource extractors as they travel between captured cities and your base, or ambush the enemy's routes to starve their war machine.

  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 1600, Core i5 6600K
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 560,Nvidia GeForce GTX 1050 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
